answer: Locks are recorded in willow, expire in pulse, and nectar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 80 aliases therefore needs 139 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4625 identities would post 2709 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
